title: What a Circle Membership Changes on a ShieldCare Plan
content:
Holding a Northbeam Circle Membership changes what a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan costs
and how a claim on it is worked.

Where the plan applies the membership discount, the membership tier's plan discount is taken off
the premium. The membership's repair labour discount is never applied on top of a covered repair,
because covered labour is already paid in full by the plan.

A member's benefit credit may be spent on a claim excess but never on a premium, because a premium
is not a service charge.

Where the membership stands in grace on a tier that suspends benefits, the discount is not applied
to a premium billed in that period, and it is not applied afterwards by way of correction.

ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection takes its pricing from the contract price book, and no
membership discount applies to it at all.

The membership tier is read as it stands on the day the premium is billed or the payout is booked,
not as it stood when the plan was sold.

### The interaction restated as questions of fact

| Fact recorded | The rule's answer |
| --- | --- |
| Membership tier carries a plan discount, plan applies the discount | The discount is taken off the premium |
| Membership carries a repair labour discount, the repair is covered | The labour discount is not applied on top; covered labour is already paid in full |
| The member wants to spend benefit credit on a premium | Not allowed; a premium is not a service charge |
| The member wants to spend benefit credit on a claim excess | Allowed |
| Membership in grace on a tier that suspends benefits | No discount on a premium billed in that period, and none afterwards by way of correction |
| The plan is ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection | No membership discount applies at all; pricing comes from the contract price book |
| The tier stood higher on the day the plan was sold than it does today | The tier is read as it stands on the day the premium is billed or the payout is booked |
